name: Open WebUI
author: open-webui
login: Sign in with WEBUI_ADMIN_EMAIL / WEBUI_ADMIN_PASSWORD from services/open-webui/.env — setup.sh seeds that owner account and public signup is off.
Grant access per user from Admin Panel → Settings.
description: ChatGPT-style chat over the ollama models already running on this box, with conversation history, model switching and document upload. Host-network container bound to 127.0.0.1:3001. The owner account is seeded by setup.sh; signup stays closed. Nothing leaves the tailnet.
